output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function does not check for overflow of the 'balances[_to]' variable, allowing users to overflow their balance and effectively become the owner of the token contract, locking their funds.
The 'migrate' function does not check for overflow of the 'totalMigrated' and 'totalTokens' variables, allowing users to overflow these counters and decrease the total supply of tokens arbitrarily.
